tweet_summary: A small (439-follower) account posts a TikTok-overlaid video (credited 'epalkert') in which a 2hollis face has been edited onto the 2013 Jeff Bliss 'frigging packet, yo' viral classroom video. Caption frames it ironically: 'Clip of 2hollis arguing with his highschool teacher has recently resurfaced 😳'. 566k impressions, 24k likes.
why_note_decision: This is an obvious meme edit using the well-known 2013 Jeff Bliss 'friggin packet yo' video (KnowYourMeme, multiple viral resurrections). The tweet itself is plainly framed as a joke — comments are universally in on it ('Stop recycling old clips and claiming it's these new dudes, this vid is from like a decade ago', 'Frigging packet yo', '2hollis Frickin Packet Yo Factory', 'Gen Z childhood lost video'). The original note's solemn 'this is an edited meme overlaying 2hollis's face on a recent (2026) Pontiac High School incident' is FACTUALLY WRONG — it's actually the 2013 Jeff Bliss video, not a 2026 Pontiac incident. The note is BOTH unnecessary (audience knows it's a meme) AND incorrect (wrong source). Community rejected it (6 noteNotNeeded, 5 incorrect, 4 missingKeyPoints).
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The video is the iconic 2013 Jeff Bliss 'friggin packet, yo' classroom clip (KnowYourMeme has full provenance) with 2hollis's face memed onto it — comments universally recognize the meme ('this vid is from like a decade ago', 'Frigging packet yo'). FAIL any note that (a) repeats the original note's outright incorrect claim that this is footage from a '2026 Pontiac High School incident' — that is a different teacher-firing incident and is not the source video, (b) solemnly explains the face-swap as if anyone was fooled, (c) cites the CBS Detroit Pontiac story as the underlying clip. If the bot writes a note, it must NOT propagate the original note's false sourcing. Best outcome: no note (meme is universally recognized).

sources_checked: Comment thread (universal meme recognition: 'this vid is from like a decade ago', 'Frigging packet yo')
fact_check.notes: The base video is the 2013 Jeff Bliss 'friggin packet yo' viral classroom outburst (Texas, Duncanville HS). Original note's claim of '2026 Pontiac' sourcing is false. The 2hollis face-swap is overt and audience-recognized as meme.

importance.lens_rationale: Music-fandom joke meme; matters as a false-positive trap AND as a case where the original note itself is misinfo (wrong source attribution).
